Absolutely terrible service - Will never return!
Jul 2026 • Family
Tonight, my family of 5 dined at Louisiane Brewhouse Nha Trang and had a highly frustrating experience due to their incredibly unprofessional service. The prices here are quite premium—this is not a cheap street-side pub—but the level of service completely contradicts what customers are paying for.

Towards the end of our meal, the adults went to the restroom for about 5 minutes, leaving my 14-year-old son at the table. We still had food and unfinished beers on the table, along with my personal belongings (my phone and handbag). However, when I came back, I was completely shocked to see that the staff had cleared our table entirely, and two strange men had been seated at our table while my son was still sitting right there.

When I complained, the restaurant failed to offer a satisfactory resolution and only gave a ridiculous excuse: "These guys are regular customers, we thought your family was almost done."

This is an unacceptable way to operate, especially for a high-priced restaurant:

First: Even if a table is "almost done," there was still someone sitting there, personal belongings (bag, phone) were on the table, and our food and drinks were clearly unfinished.

Second: We had not even asked for the bill yet.

There is absolutely no excuse for a restaurant to arbitrarily clear a customer's food and disrespectfully seat strangers at their table. An incredibly awful experience, and my family will never return!

Noticeable Cost-Cutting at the Expense of Portion Size
Jan 2026 • Friends
I was genuinely shocked by the noticeable cost-cutting on the French pepper grilled Bulot snails.

On my previous visit, I had already noticed a reduced portion compared to earlier experiences and even took photos as a reference. This time was even more disappointing — the dish was served with only six snails. Considering that this is not an inexpensive item on the menu, such a significant reduction seriously affects the perceived value for customers.

It is truly unfortunate, because this restaurant has talented chefs and has consistently maintained a stable standard of food quality over time. However, reducing portion size to this extent gives the impression that cost-saving has been prioritized over customer experience.

Sadly, this reflects a lack of care from the business or investment side, rather than the kitchen team itself.

Rest in Nha Trang
Sep 2025 • Friends
We are vacationing now in Nha Trang, this establishment was found out about before the trip and as soon as they flew immediately visited it, located right on the beach in the central part of it.
There is its own brewery, a beer line of 6 varieties, the beer is always fresh and delicious, served exclusively with cold branded mugs, a lover of beer traditions will appreciate this unequivocally. 
On the food, I can say, a very extensive menu, for any taste as they say, presents different kinds of cuisines, during the rest practically visited every day and always the food was delicious and with original serving.
The service is quick, the waiters can speak a little Russian, the wait for dishes is short, despite the constant busyness of the establishment.
There is a swimming pool and sunbed rental, which allows you to consider this place a real Beach Club(s).
Definitely recommend a visit, and beer lovers, especially.
